verdict.rationale: Virtualization support is a fair question for a desktop CPU, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack covers it. The spec-sheet items cover cache, clocks, ECC and vPro Enterprise eligibility, and the marketing pages focus on gaming, creative work and AI. None of them mentions VT-x, VT-d, hypervisor compatibility, or Docker and container workflows, and no community or hands-on item reports running VMs or containers on this chip.
